'''Brutal Pincerbeast''' is a [[Common enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|A wild creature infected by Originium. The giant beast carries numerous clusters of Originium that exhibit higher levels of activity. It also sports a thicker carapace than its ordinary counterparts.}}

==Overview==
A unique variant of [[Indigenous Pincerbeast]], but that doesn't make them more of a threat. Brutal Pincerbeasts have similar behavior to their counterpart, they still attack with a cross cut or a leap attack, dealing Physical damage. While preparing an attack, the Originium clusters on their back begin to glow. Sometimes during battle and especially after succesfully landing a hit they will taunt the player by screaming and spitting.
